{{Quote|We have heard from Trioculus, the Emperor's son, and we shall obey him, one and all!|Bertroff Hissa|<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Trioculus' Empire''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established by the [[Supreme Slavelord]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] [[Trioculus]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. However the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] faction was in fact a manipulation of the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] and the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] to prevent the rise of [[Ysanne Isard]].

Trioculus's faction was founded on trickery to pass him as the [[Triclops|Emperor's son]], who was in fact a different three-eyed mutant. A prophecy of [[Rajah Ubooki|the false]] [[Supreme Prophet]] of the Dark Side [[Kadann]] claimed that the new Emperor would hold the [[Glove of Darth Vader]].
